# A tab's floating pane goes where its tab goes: moved to a window of its
# own, its bar's buttons act in that window (they acted on the old one,
# where the tab no longer was, and nothing happened). Run with --persist.
tab:new
wait:0.6
action:new_floating_pane
wait:1.2
expect-floating:1 keyboard
action:move_tab_to_new_window
expect-windows:2
expect-floating:0
other-click:Minimize (it keeps running)
wait:0.4
# Back here: minimized, as it was put there, its capsule in the corner.
take-tab:1
wait:0.6
expect-windows:1
expect-floating:0
expect-capsules:bottom-right: libertty-ui-probe
capsule:1:click
wait:0.5
expect-floating:1 keyboard
type:echo MOVED-$((40+2))
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:MOVED-42
